Messages.Author: antero
Messages.Body:
Can an imbued do several Power actions in the same turn (i.e.
equipping) or only one (i.e. bleeding)?

-Antero

Messages.Author: tobinator
Messages.Body:
This question came up for us also. We figured that you CAN take
mutliple power actions a turn (as long as no power card is repeated).
Primarily due to the similarity to equip and recruit actions cited in
the Power card introductory text.

NRA still applies to Imbued re: bleeds, PAs, and repeated card actions
though.

My .02.

Tobin
-tpl

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
antero wrote:
> Can an imbued do several Power actions in the same turn (i.e.
> equipping) or only one (i.e. bleeding)?

The former.

Repeating bleeds is restricted by 6.1.1
Repeating political actions is restricted by 6.1.7
Repeating actions with the same action cards (by name) is restricted by
6.1.6
Repeating actions from the same card in play is restricted by 6.1.6

No other restrictions are made by the rules.
